title: Pointwise decoding of work-tape contents
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol alphabet, let $x$ be a finite input word over $\Gamma$, and let $D$ be a configuration on $x$ with $k$ work tapes. Given an embedding $e$ of the Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$, for every work tape $j$ and integer cell position $p$, the decoded tape content at $(j,p)$ is the original optional symbol at $(j,p)$ decoded to true if it equals $e(\mathrm{true})$, decoded to false if it equals $e(\mathrm{false})$, and left blank if neither equality holds.
hypotheses_covered: $\Gamma$ is a symbol type with decidable equality
